title: mana parchment
description: This mod adds magic with parchment
body:
Mana Parchment is a Minecraft mod that adds a new way to use magic through special magic parchments.

To get parchments, you must:

**1**Fight modified phantoms to collect mana,

**2**Trade with a special villager who uses an amethyst block as a crafting station.

The mod introduces elemental scrolls that allow players to harness the fundamental forces of nature.

🔥 Fire parchment: launches a destructive fireball at enemies.

💧 Water parchment: increases swimming speed and grants underwater breathing.

🌍 Earth parchment: instantly creates a protective block of earth around the player.

🌪️ Wind parchment: allows the player to fly for a short duration.

More powerful and mysterious scrolls can also be used:

🌑 Shadow parchment: summons allied monsters that attack enemy creatures.

⏳ Time parchment: stops time for a brief moment.

⚡ Lightning parchment: summons lightning strikes around the player, hitting nearby enemies.

❄️ Ice parchment: turns water beneath the player’s feet into ice, allowing them to walk on it.

The mod is designed to be simple to understand, while still adding fun and magical content to Minecraft. It works in singleplayer and multiplayer, on both client and server.

Compatible with Minecraft 1.21.8 using NeoForge.
